en: This is the Anville Town Line. Our train runs out to Anville Town, where the line ends, and back again all day.
Will you ride the train to Anville Town?
Then please board and take a seat. We'll be leaving shortly!
Anville Town is a quiet little place. Do pay it a visit when you have the time.
The train glides out of the Gear Station and rattles east past fields and woods...
With a long sigh of its brakes it rolls into Anville Town, the end of the line.
Welcome to the Battle Subway! On the Single Train you battle one on one, car after car, seven to a run.
Welcome to the Battle Subway! On the Double Train two of your Pokémon battle two at a time, car after car.
Welcome to the Battle Subway! The Multi Train is for two Trainers who battle side by side, a pair against a pair.
The Subway's cars are in the depot being made ready. Please come back once the lines are running!
